mustFix.title: Preserve the previously accepted Agent UUID grammar when removing the duplicate generic guard
mustFix.cause: Old validSession required both the generic alphanumeric-first predicate and ID.test. The new branch only uses ID.test, whose loose /^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/ accepts hyphen-leading forms. Removing the generic guard therefore newly admits IDs beyond both the old intersection and exact tool:catalog allowlist.
mustFix.impact: Malformed passive history Agent IDs become persistable outside the stated compatibility scope. This is not a demonstrated execution/owner permission bypass.
mustFix.requiredRepair: Preserve the old UUID acceptance intersection within the UUID branch, add only the exact catalog tool allowlist, and add a regression that old-rejected hyphen-leading IDs cannot replace valid storage or survive read. Do not replace the old broad ID contract with a new stricter UUID policy or change session UUID/owner/revision/expiry/dispatch.
mustFix.next: Return exact revised source/test/receipt packet to Root and central separate review. Preserve attempt1 hashes and counterexample.
